evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies `src/net_processing.cpp` to optimize how the node responds to `MSG_BLOCK` network messages.
rationale: In-place witness stripping yields an 8.9x to 9.3x speedup and significant heap reduction when serving `MSG_BLOCK` requests. While modern peers predominantly request witness blocks, eliminating full deserialization and re-hashing removes an asymmetric CPU and memory burden during block serving and enables efficient witnessless IBD (#36476).
